clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For the last 3 Financial Years) 11.85 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: The bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 11.85 lakh over the last 3 financial years.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: OEM Average Turnover (Last 3 Years) 25 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: The OEM of the offered product must have an average turnover of Rs 25 lakh over the last 3 years.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: The bidder needs 3 years of past experience in same or similar supplies.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs get complete relaxation from the experience and turnover criteria.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: Startups get complete relaxation from the experience and turnover criteria.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Document required from seller Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,OEM Authorization Certificate,OEM Annual Turnover
clauses.summary: Bidders must upload experience, past performance, turnover, OEM authorisation certificate and OEM turnover documents.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders claiming exemption from experience or turnover criteria must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: EMD Detail M /Advisory Bank State Bank of India /EMD Amount 72000
clauses.summary: An EMD of Rs 72,000 is required.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant category as per GeM GTC with the bid.
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking EMD exemption must submit valid supporting documents for their category with the bid.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: Under MSE category, only manufacturers for goods and Service Providers for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Policy.
clauses.summary: Only MSE manufacturers or service providers, not traders, are eligible for EMD exemption.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the bidder turnover criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder itself is MSE OEM of the offered products, it would be relaxed from the "OEM Average Turnover" criteria also subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: OEM turnover relaxation applies only if the MSE bidder is itself the OEM of the offered products.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from the bidder turnover criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Bidders must upload audited balance sheets or a CA/Cost Accountant certificate showing turnover.

clauses.heading: 6. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: the Bidder or its OEM of the product offered in the bid {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of Financial years as indicated above in the bid document before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: The bidder or its OEM must have regularly supplied similar products to government bodies or PSUs for the stated number of financial years.

clauses.heading: 6. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates must be submitted showing supply in each financial year.

clauses.heading: 7. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: The OEM's minimum average annual turnover over the last three years must meet the value stated in the bid.

clauses.heading: 11. Past Performance
clauses.quote: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 20% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: The bidder or its OEM must have supplied 20% of the bid quantity of similar products to government or PSU in one of the last three years.

clauses.heading: 11. Past Performance
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contract copies proving the supplied quantity in one financial year must be submitted.

clauses.heading: 1 OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS
clauses.quote: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India.
clauses.summary: For imported products, the OEM or its authorised seller must have a registered office in India for after-sales support.

clauses.quote: BID specific MAF must be attached. 17. The bidder shall submit a declaration
clauses.summary: A bid-specific manufacturer authorisation form (MAF) must be attached.
